The glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA) is a pharmacological agent utilized for the treatment of diabetes, known for its significant reno protective effects. This study aims to investigate the impact of liraglutide, a representative GLP-1RA medication, on early endothelial dysfunction in diabetic rats and elucidate its underlying mechanisms.
